headline: Latent Sparse Attention reports long-context attention speedups up to 10M tokens
summary: A preprint introduces Latent Sparse Attention (LSA), which clusters keys in a learned latent space so queries search cluster summaries rather than score every key. In author-run tests, its distilled form stayed near the tested model baselines at contexts up to 10M tokens and reduced attention-layer prefill and decode time substantially on two specific model families and H200/B300 hardware. The paper reports smaller end-to-end serving gains than the per-layer headline; its 100M-token result is an extrapolation. The linked implementation could not be accessed during this review, and no independent reproduction was performed.
